cdn.title: CDN
cdn.description: Images are served from the self-hosted edge. The deployment's capabilities and limits come from environment variables; the settings here take effect without a restart, and every process follows within seconds.

deployment.title: Deployment
deployment.notDeployed: This deployment does not provide a CDN.
deployment.notDeployedHint: Enable it with FILE_CDN_ENABLED=true and an edge (docker-compose.cdn.yml or the k8s components/cdn); see docs/architecture/backend/09-file.md §16.

settings.title: Settings
settings.servingHint: When off, new image URLs go back to presigned URLs right away. Purging continues.
settings.issuedUrlsExpireAt: CDN URLs issued before turning it off expire by {{time}}; keep the edge running until then.
settings.offConfirm: New image URLs go back to presigned URLs right away. CDN URLs already issued expire by {{time}}; keep the edge running until then.
settings.notReady: The edge nodes didn't pass the check, so the CDN can't be turned on:
settings.resourcesClamped: Some selected resource types are no longer allowed by the deployment ({{resources}}); they're not in effect.
settings.urlTtlCapClamped: Above the deployment's limit; {{value}} seconds is in effect.
settings.purgeOnDeleteOffConfirm: Deleted images stay on the edge until their URLs expire (up to {{seconds}} seconds).

nodes.title: Edge nodes
nodes.notReady: Not ready to be turned on

discovery.purgeNotConfigured: No purge endpoint is configured (FILE_CDN_PURGE_URL), so there are no nodes to check.

publicUrlResult.signatureRejected: The edge rejects the API's signatures
publicUrlResult.originAuthRejected: The origin rejects the edge (origin credential mismatch)
publicUrlResult.originUnreachable: The edge can't reach the origin
publicUrlResult.unreachable: The API can't reach the public URL

signatureResult.notEnforced: The edge doesn't verify signatures: anyone can read cached content
signatureResult.unreachable: The API can't reach the public URL

purge.title: Purge
purge.description: Remove cached copies from every edge node. Results show up in the background jobs list.
purge.paths: Object keys (one per line, e.g. images/<id>/r3/sm.webp)
purge.allConfirm: This goes to {{nodes}} node(s). For a while every image will be fetched from the origin again, which raises its load.
